name: request_type
label: Request type
help: Choose what should happen. Nothing is submitted until you review the native issue form.

name: item_operation
label: Batch change type
help: Every subject in this batch will use this operation.

name: subject_kind
label: Subject type
help: A model describes capabilities. An offering records approved access. Evidence supports facts; conditions describe rules for use. Revoke batches support offerings only.

name: subject_identity
label: Subject identity
help: The stable ID of the record. For an update, choose an existing record. For an addition, choose a new lowercase ID; check for an existing match first.

name: offering_identity
label: Offering identity
help: Choose the existing offering whose access should be withdrawn. This does not delete its history.

name: source_identity
label: Current offering identity
help: Choose the existing offering being replaced.

name: destination_identity
label: Replacement offering identity
help: Choose a new offering ID. The current offering will be withdrawn in the same request.

name: subject_identities
label: Subject identities
help: One stable lowercase ID per line, up to 25. Every record uses the same type and operation. Use the lookup to add existing records.

name: purpose
label: Purpose
help: In one sentence, what do you need? For example: provide a reviewed model for document summarisation.
placeholder: Example: Register a governed vendor before its models or offerings are proposed

name: requested_outcome
label: Requested outcome
help: Describe what should be true when the request is complete. Use the lookup to reference models, services or exact condition versions.
placeholder: Example: Create the vendor record acme-ai; leave model and offering approval unchanged.

name: reason
label: Why is this needed?
help: Explain who needs this and why the current catalogue is insufficient.
placeholder: Example: The vendor must exist as a governed identity before related records can reference it.

name: source_type
label: Evidence source type
help: How was the bounded observation obtained?

name: source_url
label: Evidence source URL
help: Official HTTPS source for the batch observation.

name: scope_ref
label: Opaque scope reference
help: A non-secret internal scope label. Never enter an account ID.

name: partition
label: Provider partition
help: Provider partition for the observation scope.

name: region
label: Source region
help: Region in which the read observation was made.

name: inference_service
label: Inference service
help: Choose the governed service for this batch, such as AWS Bedrock.

name: candidate_evidence
label: Supporting observations
help: Optional. One observation per line: official HTTPS URL | RFC 3339 UTC time | sha256- digest. Use the evidence lookup for retained observations, or enter the exact values from a new observation.

name: acceptance
label: Acceptance checks
help: One check per line, up to 25. For example: the named model and its evidence agree.
placeholder:
The new record has the requested stable identity at its canonical path.
The record and referenced evidence pass Modelo validation.
